r0.why: Remote-controlled vehicle on Mars [1]; advantages over stationary landers [2]; different purpose than MRO [3].

r1.why: Six successful rovers as of May 2021, five JPL with landing years [5]; Zhurong CNSA [6]; first non-American on May 14, 2021 [12].

r2.why: Sojourner landing, ~100 m, contact lost Sept 27 1997 [19]-[21]; Spirit landing, 7.73 km, stuck in sand, last comms Mar 22 2010 [22]-[24].

r3.why: Landing date, longevity record 5,352 sols/5,498 days, 45.16 km, dust storm last status 10 June 2018, declared complete Feb 13 2019 in [25]-[28].

r4.why: Curiosity dates, Gale Crater near Mount Sharp, still operating Nov 2026 [13],[14]; Perseverance design, landing, Ingenuity, operational [15]-[18].

r5.why: Landing in southern Utopia Planitia [29]; 90 vs 347 sols, 1,921 m [30]; deactivated May 2022, dust prevented reactivation [31],[32].

r6.why: Habitability/taphonomy/organic carbon primary objective [8]; 2016 report on ancient life and fluvio-lacustrine water [7].
